tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand green. Home page ground and the Home/cover color. Text on it: white (8.68:1) or sage (5.82:1). Also the active/hover outline on sage (5.82:1).

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Brand plum. About page ground and the guide's text color on mint. Text on it: white (11.59:1), sage (7.77:1) or lavender (4.62:1).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Soft green. Project page ground; the logo ink on forest, plum, olive and brown. Text on it: forest (5.82:1) or plum (7.77:1), never white (1.49:1).

tokens.name: brown
tokens.usage: Earth brown, one of the three final pairing colors. Inquire page ground. Text on it: white (6.54:1) or mint (5.5:1). The business cards set ink (2.49:1) and lavender (2.61:1) on it; keep those for the logo at large size only.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Olive. Instagram page ground. Text on it: white (6.1:1) or mint (5.13:1); sage (4.08:1) only at 24px and up.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: The pastel pop and the purple of the final pairings. Index numerals, the logo on forest and plum, and text on plum (4.62:1). Ink on lavender reads 6.5:1.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Cornflower pastel, paired with forest. Grounds for ink text (6.41:1); forest on blue (3.41:1) only at 24px and up or for the logo.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: The brand guide's page ground. Light surfaces and footers; plum (9.75:1) or ink (13.71:1) text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black for text on mint, sage, lavender and blue. The guide's pairing chart also shows a deeper #100f0d in one disc; ink covers both.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text on forest, plum, brown and olive; mats behind image grids.

tokens.name: project-lilac
tokens.usage: From the website deck, not the brand guide: a project's loading color before its photo is revealed. Label text on it: plum (5.63:1).

tokens.name: project-ivory
tokens.usage: From the website deck: project loading color. Label text: plum or forest.

tokens.name: project-butter
tokens.usage: From the website deck: project loading color. Label text: plum or forest.

tokens.name: project-blush
tokens.usage: From the website deck: project loading color. Label text: plum or forest.

tokens.name: project-taupe
tokens.usage: From the website deck: project loading color. Label text: plum (5.18:1); forest fails (4.07:1).

tokens.name: ground-home
tokens.usage: Home page background (website deck page 1-3).

tokens.name: ground-about
tokens.usage: About page background (website deck pages 4-5).

tokens.name: ground-project
tokens.usage: Project pages background (website deck pages 6-15).

tokens.name: ground-inquire
tokens.usage: Inquire page background (website deck page 16; the deck's tan is this brown).

tokens.name: ground-instagram
tokens.usage: Instagram page background (website deck page 17).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Hover and focus outline on project tiles and controls on sage and light grounds; on dark grounds the outline uses the current text color.
